items.text: The local lord set Gavashaw up as a rival to Makkek, giving him a large mansion in the east of Bornwater, and Makkek sent Szeth to kill him. When Szeth broke in, he found Gavashaw's head on a table; a masked figure told him that Gavashaw and Makkek were both dead and that someone else now held Szeth's Oathstone.
